question: When can sound be reflected, and how is its manifestation related to hearing?
premises: An unmanifest sound is not reflected.
The manifestation of a sound and its hearing occur together.
This simultaneity is stated in relation to the second moment.
inference: Only a manifest sound can be reflected, and its manifestation and hearing are temporally simultaneous.
uncertainties: The reference to dvitīyake kṣaṇe spans into verse 34 and is read across the verse boundary.
plain_english: An unmanifest sound is not reflected; its manifestation and hearing occur at the same time, in the second moment.
